summary: Iteration_59 revision-scoring changes verified. Created /app/backend/tests/test_revision_scoring.py with 11 tests covering (a) INVESTOR_SCORE_INSTRUCTION prompt shipped with SCORING CALIBRATION / 65-79 / Traction Mode / REVISION BONUS / +10 to +15 / PRIOR ATTEMPTS ON THIS EXACT MILESTONE phrases; (b) _prior_attempts_on_same_milestone_section() helper — empty on no priors, empty on None/empty milestone_id, header + 'Founder Progress Score awarded: NN/100' lines, chronological ordering, exclude_submission_id honoured, feedback (up to 800 chars) included, instructor_feedback preferred over ai_feedback, no score line when readiness_score missing; (c) build_cumulative_context() end-to-end — passes milestone_id + exclude_submission_id and both prior scores (62, 71) + both feedback snippets appear while current attempt is excluded; (d) backwards compatibility — legacy positional call without milestone_id returns a valid string with NO 'PRIOR ATTEMPTS' section leak; (e) milestone_id passed but no priors -> no PRIOR ATTEMPTS header. Regression: full test_venture_path.py + test_score_display.py suites still pass unchanged. Combined suite: 45 passed, 0 failed.
critical_code_review_comments: _prior_attempts_on_same_milestone_section uses `if prior_score` (line 735) which will suppress the score line when readiness_score == 0. Not a bug per business rules (0 shouldn't occur — parse_readiness_score clamps to min 1), but consider `if prior_score is not None` for defensive correctness.

build_cumulative_context caps sections at max_chars=6000. Prior-milestone attempts are appended FIRST so they get priority — good. However if a student has many prior attempts (helper reads up to 20) with large feedback (800 chars each) + 500 chars excerpts, the block alone could consume >6000 chars and starve the course-wide + prior-week sections. Consider capping the number of prior attempts included to ~3 most recent.
server.py is 8158 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Splitting is out of scope for this iteration but worth flagging for a future refactor pass.
test_credentials: Not used — direct MongoDB seed per test_credentials.md guidance.
seed_data_creation: Per-test TEST_-prefixed submissions in `submissions` collection; cleaned in fixture teardown. No persistent test data left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_revision_scoring.py rebinds server.client/server.db to a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient per test (function-scoped event_loop fixture) to avoid motor's 'Future attached to different loop' error when calling server async helpers directly. Reuse this pattern for any future direct-async-call tests against server.py. pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var when combined with test_venture_path.py / test_score_display.py — sourced from /app/frontend/.env.
